scientific_integrity: The proof uses exact identities valid over every algebraically closed field of odd characteristic. Finite-field checks only corroborate the proof; they cannot establish its universal quantifiers.
scientific_limitations: The radical and minimal-prime decomposition is determined; global nilpotents and embedded associated primes are not.
The characteristic-three gradient critical scheme need not lie in the cubic hypersurface.
Two-dimensional extremal planes were previously classified; originality concerns the complementary line regime.
Possible unindexed or implicit pre-existing radical formulas remain a residual originality risk.
title: All reduced components of the odd-characteristic symmetric-cubic critical locus
